row.evidence: Tanium's Cloud user guide says "Tanium Cloud supports SCIM 2.0 and supports Microsoft Entra ID and Okta as SCIM providers"; Tanium publishes no pricing and sells through a demo/contact-sales process.
row.notes: Quote-only: no public pricing (tanium.com/pricing is 404; buyers request a demo), so SCIM is gated per rule 6a. SCIM 2.0 is documented for Tanium Cloud with Entra ID (gallery app 'Tanium SSO' with a provisioning tutorial) and Okta; other SCIM clients need Tanium Support. SCIM token expires after one year. JIT on SAML is available but must be off when SCIM is used. Roles map via Tanium user groups. On-premises Tanium has SAML docs but no SCIM page found. Tanium licenses by endpoint, so per-user prices do not apply.

scim.base_url: SCIM API URL shown per Tanium Cloud instance in Tanium Account > Cloud Instances > Administration > Configure SCIM (pattern not published)

auth.token_source: Tanium Account > Cloud Instances > Administration > Identity Provider Settings > Actions > Configure SCIM > Enable SCIM; token shown once (copy within five minutes); Rotate Token available
auth.notes: 'bearer' inferred from token pasted as the IdP secret token.

operations.notes: Entra tutorial: create, remove, keep attributes in sync, groups and memberships. Tanium docs: removing a user from the IdP group removes their access.

deprovision.data_retained: Disabling SCIM entirely deletes all SCIM-managed users and groups and their RBAC configuration; deleting a user stops scheduled content they own.
deprovision.notes: Whether IdP deprovisioning deletes or locks the Tanium user is not stated.

roles.how: Group-to-role mapping: assign roles, computer groups and personas to SCIM-provisioned Tanium user groups in Tanium Console

limitations.text: Only Microsoft Entra ID and Okta are supported SCIM providers; others need Tanium Support.
JIT provisioning must be disabled on all domains; existing JIT or locally created users must be deleted before SCIM can manage them.
SCIM token is shown once, must be copied within five minutes, and expires after one year.
Disabling SCIM deletes all SCIM-managed users and groups and their RBAC configuration.
Documented for Tanium Cloud; no SCIM page found for Tanium on-premises.

okta.notes: https://www.okta.com/integrations/tanium/ returns 404; Tanium's Okta guide uses a manually created SAML app integration.
